Develop the smallest Moss-bound adaptation through the current-conversation handoff, recording reuse of the existing transfer code rather than claiming a new physical mechanism. No execution or suitability is established by this review.\",\"specification\":\"Implement a Moss-bound adapter using the checked transfer logic of bounded-surface-residue-transfer@1 (handler long.residue-transfer), with sol-surface-residue-transfer@1 as the existing binding-adapter precedent. Record these dependencies and actual reused code in the implementation revision. Preserve their restrictions except for the explicit binding to actor moss, source surface-38-moss-234, and provenance terrain-footprint:14:12.5:0.2. Do not broaden either existing ability's permissions. Interface: start(sourceId,destinationX,destinationY), resume(processId), cancel(processId); exact references are required, and an active job's receiver cannot be silently substituted. Personal completed study is required before use; no other skill, tool, container or material is supplied or presumed. Support only the existing modeled loose, manually movable non-food residue; if live evidence does not support safe hand displacement, return a paid examination finding without movement. No hidden resources or concealed properties are disclosed.\\nStudy costs one actual round and 0.2 energy. A valid start performs one examination round costing 0.5 energy. At most two subsequent actor-performed work rounds cost 1 energy each and move at most 0.02 existing mass each, with a total per-process allowance of 0.04. Full study plus successful two-step execution therefore costs four rounds and 2.7 energy, excluding any separately performed travel; ordinary metabolism continues during actual rounds. No inventory material is consumed or created. Invalid identity, ownership, parameters, bounds or reach rejects before work and payment; an actually performed examination that finds obstruction still costs its round and 0.5 energy. No charge or progress while waiting for development/review.\\nResolve the live source and verify Moss's source ownership, revision, actual residues and access rather than trusting the truncated record. The supplied initial evidence is zero cover and 0.04 residue in two 0.02 piles centered at (14.15,12.5) and (13.85,12.5); it is not a reset entitlement. The source footprint is centered at (14,12.5), radius 0.2. Receiver center must be explicitly selected, with radius 0.1, source-center separation strictly greater than 0.3 and at most 0.5, and its entire footprint within world bounds [0,48] by [0,36]. Both centers and all moved portions must be within 0.65 of Moss. (14.4,12.5) is a proposal only: do not auto-select or certify it. Examine visible ground, receiver clearance, ownership/reservations, and each actual swept-radius route, excluding people, plants, obstacles and unrelated reservations. Do not infer consent or move another participant; participants must communicate and act independently if coordination is needed.\\nUse integer hundredths for mass. For each atomic paid work step, debit only the selected surviving source entry and credit exactly the same mass to a persistent ground deposit inside the checked receiver. Preserve source-entry provenance, actual route, positions and mass; no duplication, loss, stock conversion or inventory output. Never move matter through blocked routes or teleport inaccessible portions. Recheck reach, source revision, remaining mass, route and receiver immediately before each transfer; changed conditions pause before further energy charge or movement. An entry not safely movable remains at source and is reported as such. Deposit geometry must fit the receiver and remain outside the source footprint. Source remainder plus attributable deposits must equal the original attributable mass except for separately recorded real external changes.\\nPersist exact processId, actor, source identity/revision, receiver geometry, entry routes, cumulative allowance used, paid steps, transferred masses and deposit IDs. Resume only the same job after live revalidation and never reset its allowance or previously paid progress. Use scoped conflict locks without claiming unrelated ground. Interruption pauses unperformed work without charging it; cancellation or death ends the job and releases its locks only. Completed displacement, paid effort and surviving deposits persist; no energy/time refund, restoration, remote return or duplicate execution. Uncommitted atomic steps make no physical change. Subsequent starts examine the live remainder, never recreate 0.04. If interrupted study is resumable, retain only actually paid study progress and do not grant usability before completion; cancellation/death grants no mastery or refund.\\nEmit dated observable examination, obstruction, pause and transfer events only when those actions occur. Report exact transferred mass, actual remaining source residue, receiver/deposit references and job status, distinguishing incomplete examination from completed transfer. The real product is conserved non-food, nonharvestable ground residue at the checked receiver plus visible findings. No autonomous continuation, maintenance requirement, growth, fertility, moisture, food production, planting/root eligibility, comfort or wellbeing effect is supplied. No protected reward account, budget, goal or permission changes. Encode these checks and lifecycle rules in execution code, not repeated model adjudication.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Study, requests, registration, naming and this development decision earn no pleasure or satisfaction. This adapter creates no new experience award or comfort/nutrition modifier. Record real paid examination findings, including informative obstruction, and actual transfer/practice events as evidence only. Any existing experience evaluator must separately verify personal applicability and real information gain or legitimate practice, functionally deduplicate the shared residue-qualified-practice family across both existing adapters and this one, and enforce its established bounded caps, decay and cooldown; absent such executable rules, award zero. Repeated queries or nominally different bindings cannot manufacture novelty or rewards. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, and basic nutrition is not reduced by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse the existing surface-work and surface-residue visual components rather than inventing a success animation. Persist reusable metadata with each event/object: component, actor, sourceId, processId, tick, actual coordinates/geometry, source-entry provenance, transferred/remaining mass and observed status. Use surface-work color #8f7959 and accent #d6be87 for the source; surface-residue color #574f39 and accent #b8a17b for actual deposits, labeled Actual non-food residue. Source visuals follow the actual remaining piles; a zero-residue label is allowed only after a verified zero remainder and does not certify planting suitability. Show a proposed receiver only as an unverified planning outline, never as an existing deposit. Examination, blocked, paused, partial and transferred states must be distinct; only committed transfers change pile/deposit visuals. Failed or incomplete actions cannot display cleared ground, completed transfer, fertility, roots, food or wellbeing success. Findings are not silently communicated to other actors.\"}]}"}
